translation.name: U VURUNGAN ROF FOUN TEN GOV NANE JISAS KRAIS

book.name: Matiu
book.title: MATIU Vurungan Rof Nane Jisas Krais Te Kirkir Iny E Matiu

content: Tsue Fapapaar Nan Guainy Nan Fanging
Jisas tsue of pis ratuarin mes tsue fapapaar.
“A Waan iny Gormirmir faarei non a isen a aatouf te kakouiny guainy nan fanging tana guei tsoiny tsunia.
Ya jiats raton tsoiny binun tsuan ma nai finaum mi ri tana vainy te nom vebus ma naa mi ri tan guainy nan fanging, ser baainy ma naa me.

Ya jiats pis nats ton mes panainy tsoiny binun tsuan fiisen men vegiau to, tsue of ir yam a vainy te nom vebus muan ma naa mi ri, ‘Guainy nan fanging te kakouiny bus anyo, a fo bulumakau tsoiny ana fo mes a fo venoo nan fafaruet te peepee er ana kakoun onot fiisen me na fo mes a foka kan, taami yam tan guainy nan fanging!’

Sana vainy to te nom vebus nan guainy nana fanging to baainy ma naa me, ri naa vavis erato a tou kat a fo binun tsuar: isen tsuri naa fi en tanun tsuan, ana mesmes naa kan fi enato tana numaa iny fafiifoiny tsuan.
Ana mesapan tsuri na vainy nots raton tsoiny binun, ri rarapits ratuari ser atsuiny famat kan ratuari.
Ana aatouf peits fiisok tsun nato, ya jiats raton vainy puaan tsuan, ana ri atsaatsun ratuari ri kuruiny ton ngats fan tsurin vainy to te atsuiny famat ir tsoiny binun tsunia.
Ana ya fikoo ton mes tsoiny binun tsuan, ‘Guainy nana fanging tsonyo kakoun en,’ te tsue fi ya, ‘sana ri na vainy te nom vebus pisiin ser gima tamainy ma naa me.
Jio, kuar fi yam tan fo sanaan te vivagutan ror ana mi te fanat rari na fokinai faavot te onot iny sab fi romi ri, er naa mito tan guainy nana fanging.’

An tsoiny binun naa bus rato tana fo sanaan, ri guam rato na vainy a kinai te onot iny sab ari, rin vainy iring an vainy rof. Ri naa mito ana pan via enato tsuri na vainy te naa me tan guainy nana fanging.
“Ana aatouf naa to gagon ma nak ya na vainy ana ya tagei to na isen a mes gima vau men vaun rof nana fanging.
‘O ka, fei te ising fi mi nyi ei, to sa nyi naa me gagon ana nyi na sikia tu vau nana fanging?’ rangats fi ya na aatouf. Sana mes to vanumui enato.

Ana aatouf tsue to tan tsoiny binun tsuan, ‘Kotskots yam a niman ya ana moun ya, mi te gargar naa ya jiarasan tana uurup tana pan iny fasaraa unya aya ayei nai tangis non ya te kakuts ngiisngiis a ngiisin.’”
Ai Jisas fakap ton vegiau Tsuan sa tsue na ka, “A vainy a kinai fiisok te nom vebus, sana ina tee karaup tsun te pisan rari.”
Takis Tan Gamaman
Farasi naa ri kat ton fakats ma fataraatsua ri Jisas tan fo rangat.

Ri jiats na ton matisian tsuri ana tee vainy ten Herot unya ten Jisas. “Tsoiny fifaatsuts,” tsue fi ri Tsunia, “Mam nat marom Anyi natiny tsue iny rom a man. Nyi fafaatsuts iny rom a man nane Gov tana vainy, ana Nyi gim kan rom ma aspeer ta mes tan fakats tsuri, tana saa, kainon to te kaa fi mirorin asangan gen vainy babainy.
Tsue of mamimam, saf fakats Tsumanyi na? Te toobing non tan faun tsura ma foiny takis fi naa ten Sisa na aatouf iny Roum ge na sikia?”
Jisas nat faamuan iny fakat fanunun iring tsuri, ana Ya tsue to, “Amin vainy kat mapam! Kat fei sam fataraatsua Varonyo ei?
Faatok Vanyo yam ta isen ta painy moni kainy foiny takis!” Ri mei mito na isen a painy moni,
Ana Ya rangats ratuari, “A nain e sei ana asangan e sei to aya ee, tana moni to?”
Ri biny Towa ser tsue na ka, “E Sisa na aatouf.” Ai Jisas tsue to tsuri, “Jio, fainy yam e Sisa na foka ten Sisa, am fainy to Gov, a foka ten Gov.”
Te nongoiny arin vegiau to, ri ngian fiisok tsun rato: ana ri tsun osing Towa ser naa er.
A Tou Tsun Fatabin Tana Mat
Tan ar nainy to aya, ri na tee vainy tana taa Sadusi natiny tsue ror a sikia ta tou tsun fatabin tana mat, naa mito ten Jisas.

“Tsoiny fifaatsuts,” te rangat fi ri Ya, “Moses fafaatsuts sa tsue na ka: ‘Te mat fi non a mes, a sikia tu guei, an famuinyasiny tsunia ma fanging a amov to, ma kaa mi ri tu guei, a faarei ton guei tan fo mumuinyasiny taman tsuan te mat.’
Eye, te kaa me na fo mumuinyasiny ina fits te kaakaa. Vaamuan fanging to, ana ya maten nato a sikia tu guei, ana amov fanging to na fafuan narari.
Jesan te kat fi kan a fafuan ana fafofopis, nai ruak tan fafakap nar mumuinyasiny to, mat fakap er.
Ai tan fafakap, amov to mat patsu nato.
Eye, to tan nainy tana tou tsun fatabin tana mat, e sei tsurin ina fits mumuinyasiny to ari te nai faarei non a tsoiny tana moun to aya ee? Ari faavot to te fanging ya.”
Jisas biny ratuari, “Mi iring em, tana saa, mi pin iny rom Vegiau Ten Gov, ana parits ten Gov.
To te tsun fatabin fi ror vainy mat, ri faarei raror morena iny Gormirmir, an tsoiny min moun a sikia tu fifanging pis na aya.
Ai to kan, tana tou tsun fatabin tana mat, mi gima gogosias vegiau te tsue of mami Gov ge?

content.text: ‘Anyo na Gov ten Abraham, ana Gov ten Aisak, ana Gov ten Jekop.’ (Naus Osing 3.6)

content: Faarei non a Gov, Ayei na sikia ma Gov tan vainy mat, Ayei na Gov tan vainy toto.”
Te nongoiny vainy a kinai vegiau to, ri saar rato.
A Faun Te Karap Fafis Non
Te nongoiny Farasin vegiau ten Jisas te kat favanumui na vainy te gim ror ma faamainy a tou tsun fatabin tana mes tana mat, ri suur faavot mito.
Ana isen tsuri na tsoiny fifaatsuts tan Faun te kirkir iny e Moses, pon to ma fataraatsua Yan rangat,
“Tsoiny fifaatsuts, a saf a ar Faun te kirkir iny e Moses te karap fafis non tan fo faun faavot na?”
Jisas biny ratuari,

content.text: “‘Nyi ma mangiir a Tsunaun a Gov tsumanyi fiisen men komam faavot, fiisen men aavem faavot, ai fiisen men fakats faavot tsumanyi.’ (Faun 6.5)

content: Ayei na vaamuan nan faun te karap fafis non.
Ana fafuan nar faun te karap fafis non, ito te faarei kainy non ya:

content.text: ‘Nyi ma mangiir fifakokoro tsuam faarei te mangiir rom anyi na tsivom.’ (Livai 19.18)

content: Fo Faun te kirkir iny e Moses ana fo fifaatsuts tan fo kuigin tsutsun ror tana fuan a Faun to.”
U Rangat Nane Krais, A Tsoiny Fiisaup
Te vaaguam men Farasi, Jisas rangats ratuari,
“Saf fakats tsumi ten Krais na? Ana Ayei fatsubnaain fi naa non ten sei?” Ri biny Towa ser tsue na ka, “Ayei na tsubnaain ten Devit fatoobing.”
Ya tsue to tsuri, “Kat pas fei san Aaven Taabos pokei mi Ya nguen e Devit, sa koo Ya na ‘Tsunaun’ ei? Devit tsue na ka,

content.text: ‘Tsunaun e Gov te tsue tana Krais a Tsunaun tsonyo, Gum nei tan panaainy matou Tsonyo, onot non te fakei finy Ronyon fo vainy te koma iring marom Anyi er kaa to fain a mou Manyi.’ (Vadou 110.1)

content: Devit koo Krais, a ‘Tsunaun tsonyo,’ Sana ayei koo kainy Ya na tsubnaain Tsunia. Kat fei ma fatsubnaain pis Ya ei?”
A sikia ta isen tsuri ma biny e Jisas tan ta ar vegiau, ai tan ar nainy to aya ai tan mes a fo nainy kan, sikia ta isen tsuri ma su'eets Ya tan ta fo rangat, ri te oraav.
